source_title: Kilmarnock fan views on 3-1 defeat to Dundee - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your opinions following the 3-1 defeat at Dens Park that leaves Kilmarnock bottom of the Premiership.
Kenny : Surely Neil McCann's time is up, there has to be change.
Brett : Seriously embarrassing stuff. As far back as the last transfer window, the fans were saying that we needed a decent centre-back and we're still waiting. Bringing inexperienced youngsters in on loan isn't working.
Wolfgang : Eleven goals conceded in four games and only one of those came against a frequent top-four team. September felt like we were stabilising in defence, October has felt like we're nursing a hangover celebrating last month.
Isobel : The manager has to take the blame for this defeat. We are nose-diving into the Championship.
Frank : I think it's fair to say that the management team have lost the confidence of almost every Killie fan. His substitutions made the team weaker which shows his lack of tactical awareness. Billy Bowie should thank him for keeping us up last season and tell him to go.
Anna : Enough is enough. It's time McCann was sacked after last night's atrocious performance at Dundee. First half wasn't bad but the second was the worst ever in so many ways. We are bottom of the league with only two wins from 11 and 26 goals conceded. With form like that and the threat of relegation, I can't see Bowie doing anything other than firing McCann. Made me laugh last night with him saying the team had so much promise, well they showed none of that last night.
